title: Project Manager - Medicaid Youth Transition Services (776637)
description:
Project Manager – Medicaid Youth Transition Services

Are you passionate about driving meaningful change for justice-involved youth? We’re looking for a Project Manager to lead the statewide rollout of critical Medicaid services that help young people successfully transition back into their communities. This is an opportunity to shape programs that directly impact health, equity, and futures.

As Project Manager, you will play a key role in coordinating policy development, ensuring compliance with federal requirements, and building cross-sector partnerships. You’ll work with providers, courts, managed care organizations, and other stakeholders to design and implement models that connect youth to the care and support they need—before and after release from juvenile settings.

What You’ll Do:

  • Develop and implement policies and operational models for service delivery

  • Build and monitor dashboards, KPIs, and evaluation strategies to track outcomes

  • Facilitate stakeholder groups, task forces, and training sessions across the state

  • Design workflows that ensure care continuity and connect behavioral health, medical, and community supports

  • Ensure compliance with Medicaid and federal policy requirements, making programs audit-ready

  • Provide technical expertise to partners, helping align systems and reduce gaps in care

What We’re Looking For:

  • Strong project management experience with Medicaid, juvenile justice, behavioral health, or public systems reform projects

  • Deep understanding of project management tools, methodologies, and best practices

  • Bachelor’s degree in social work, criminal justice, psychology, or related field

  • Excellent communication skills—able to clearly convey technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Proven organizational skills to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Willingness to report ONSITE M-F, working 7.5 hours per day
  • Requires approx. 30% in state travel to various agencies
     

Highly Valued Experience:

  • Knowledge of EPSDT, TCM, Medicaid managed care, or juvenile justice systems

  • Familiarity with state health care delivery systems and Medicaid waivers/SPAs

  • Experience implementing CMS policy changes or new Medicaid benefits

  • Experience working with justice-involved individuals and cross-sector teams

  • Project management certification or equivalent large-scale implementation experience

  • Prior experience in government or public-sector settings

This is more than a project management role—it’s a chance to lead initiatives that improve lives, strengthen communities, and advance access to care for vulnerable youth.

title: REMOTE Clinical Help Desk Admin (305)
description:
THIS IS A REMOTE OPPORTUNITY
Pay Rate - $19/hr (+$1/hr for Spanish/English Bilingual Candidates)

This position is responsible for providing high level customer service to individuals seeking assistance, and providers or system users. 

 Admin/Helpdesk Duties and Responsibilities: 

  • Provide high level customer support to internal and external customers to reach a one call resolution
  • Perform operational tasks to assure project and program service level requirements and goals are met
  • Perform all job duties in compliance with person first standards, HIPPA guidelines, and company confidentiality policies and procedures 
  • Handle inbound calls related to Medicaid application assistance, Level of Care assessments and Intake counseling 
  • Follow up with customers to ensure their needs are met and address any queries or concerns
  • Ability to document call interactions in more than one system (data entry) 
  • Warm handoffs to calls that need to be redirected 
  • Escalate calls to management as needed 
  • Maintain a high level of confidentiality while performing all work tasks

Minimum Requirements:

  • High school diploma or GED required, and 6 months of relevant professional experience required, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Prior work experience in customer service and data entry
  • Computer literacy with proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
  • Must have private and secure working space with reliable high speed internet service
    • Minimum 20 Mbps download speeds/50 Mbps for shared internet connectivity  
    • Minimum 5 Mbps upload speeds 
  • This is a remote position; however, candidates must use the client-provided computer, which operates on a PC/Windows system. Personal devices cannot be used for this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • College degree or equivalent
  • Experience within Clinical Services or within a HIPAA-regulated environment
  • Intermediate to advanced computer skills
  • 2+ years of experience in customer service or related position

Requested Knowledge Base and Skills: 

  • Passionate about providing superior customer service, while being able to handle client questions in a quick and professional manner with one call resolution 
  • Possess excellent listening, verbal communication skills, and demonstrate a sincere approach to helping others 
  • Comfortable working independently and within a team environment. You can multitask and be agile as needed  
  • Proven ability to multitask and exhibit excellent attention to detail while consistently following established procedures and processing transactions

title: RN Case Manager – Utilization Review (Remote)
description:
We are seeking an experienced RN Case Manager to join our Utilization Review team. This is a 100% remote role requiring strong skills in inpatient case management and utilization management.

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8-hour shifts with weekend rotation.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct utilization reviews using MCG and InterQual.

  • Complete patient assessments and support discharge planning.

  • Drive progression of care and collaborate with interdisciplinary teams.

  • Document accurately in Epic.

Requirements:

  • RN license (Indiana or Compact state).

  • Minimum 2+ years of inpatient case management experience.

  • Proficient with MCG and InterQual.

  • Strong independent work and communication skills.

  • Preferred: Certification in Case Management.

Perks: Remote work, structured orientation, and opportunity to support a system-wide utilization management team.
